title.en: Insurance runs out while the offering is open

description.en: The cargo policy approaches its expiry: the agent warns a week ahead, then pauses the offering once cover has lapsed. Simulated clock.
description.zh: 货运保险临近到期：Agent 提前一周预警，保险失效后暂停发行。使用模拟时钟。

label.en: 8 days left: outside the warning window
label.zh: 还剩 8 天：尚未进入预警窗口
